$comment: Pack Rat bridge protocol v1. Draft-07 style, restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mjs supports (no $ref/oneOf), so this file holds three independent schemas — command, result and status — each validated separately (app/contracts.test.mjs does one validate() call per shape). command = one line of <dataDir>/bridge/tazuo/queue.jsonl, written by POST /api/bridge (app/vault-server.mjs) and read by adapters/tazuo/packrat-bridge.py. result = one entry of status.results, keyed by the command's id. status = <dataDir>/bridge/tazuo/status.json, written by packrat-bridge.py (alive is always rfc3339_now(); a clean stop adds stopped:true, never the old numeric 0) and read by GET /api/bridge/status.
